PP-OCR models bundled here are official PaddleOCR PP-OCRv6 small detection and
recognition weights, converted to ONNX and packaged by RapidOCR. The upstream
model weights are copyright Baidu and/or the applicable PaddleOCR rights holders
and are licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0.

Converted from an official PaddleOCR model to the indicated inference format
and packaged for use with RapidOCR. The upstream model weights are copyright
Baidu and/or the applicable PaddleOCR rights holders and are licensed under
the Apache License, Version 2.0.

These files contain no plan data.

See LICENSE-RapidOCR-Apache-2.0.txt, MODEL_LICENSES.md, and
LICENSE-onnxruntime-web-MIT.txt.
